why: MATLAB R2026a: `clearvars -global qzv qzw` removes the global `qzw` and keeps the non-global `qzv`, so `tidy(qzv)` is `Gizmo::tidy`; `clearvars qzx -global` warns that the `-global` flag after an item is ignored and removes `qzx` as `clearvars qzx` would, so `qzx` is no variable at `qzx(1)`, which calls the function `qzx` (step 15 round 8).
